clips.title: The story
paras: Defias operatives have hidden their orders at Addle's Stead in western Duskwood. The docket gives Stormwind's search for its missing emissary a lead into the Brotherhood's plans.

Master Elling Trias points investigators toward Duskwood as they follow leads on the kingdom's missing diplomat. Watcher Backus has noted unusual Defias movements converging on Addle's Stead, the derelict farm south of the road from Westfall. A strongbox on the property holds the Defias Docket. Its records track the Brotherhood's movements, revealing work that reaches beyond highway robbery and local banditry.
